pre_fix_detail: Same person selected vendor AND approved PO — unchecked vendor markup risk
fix_action: ERP: vendor selection = dispatch team account · PO approval = management account · Accounts hard-separated

pre_fix_detail: Rate negotiator also processed payment — no second check on overbilled rates
fix_action: Rate negotiation = dispatch team · Payment release = finance/mgmt with mandatory counter-signature

pre_fix_detail: Receiving clerk had active ERP procurement access — could falsify receiving records against PO
fix_action: Procurement access removed from all warehouse receiving accounts in ERP · Role audit completed

pre_fix_detail: Payment preparer also had release authority — single point of failure for fraudulent payment
fix_action: Payment preparation ≠ payment release · Manager counter-signature required in ERP before any outgoing wire
